designed_as: structure + current status + acceptance criteria (NOT a claim that recovery was performed)

state_index.what_it_is: 32 rows of (inst, event, J0) plus seven scalar per-arm J values

full_snapshot.what_would_be_needed: a RecourseSnapshotV2 (schema_version 'recourse_snapshot_v2' or the cold-chain 'recourse_snapshot_v3_cc') per state
full_snapshot.evidence: the sealed per_state.json contains none of the 38 snapshot fields (see field_coverage); summary.json records no snapshot either

deterministic_recovery_already_executed.note: no recovery, restore or resume has ever been run for these 32 states; nothing in the sealed asset or the audit trail reports one

interface.capture: capture_recourse_snapshot(env, inst_idx, clock, event_id, reveal_idx, vehicles, traces, served_mask, all_customers=None)

legend.DERIVABLE: recoverable from a stored value without guessing
legend.MISSING: not stored anywhere in this asset; NOT inferred

summary.additional_anchor_not_in_schema: J0 (float, one per state) - not a snapshot field but usable as a recovery anchor

per_state_table.note: the same coverage applies to each of the 32 states; no state has any extra stored field

recoverability_judgement.recovery_route: deterministic re-collection: re-run the registered collection (split='cal', max_per_instance=2) over the registered data with the registered code, capture a RecourseSnapshotV2 at each decision point, and require the (inst, event, J0) triple to reproduce exactly
recoverability_judgement.why_not_read_only: the collector derives states from a live env run; reproducing them executes the simulator and therefore is a NEW execution, not a replay of a stored snapshot

required_input_identities_for_a_future_r.note: full 64-hex sha256 read from the 3080 host at audit time; all must match before a recovery run may claim identity
required_input_identities_for_a_future_r.contract_and_profile: MISSING from this audit: the cold-chain contract hash and objective profile hash used by the sgbs_fixed_cal run are NOT recorded in the sealed asset (its summary.json has no identity block); they must be located or declared before a recovery run can claim identity

split_and_collection_parameters.mask_seed_rule: per-instance seed = the instance's visit counter (Probe.plan)

per_state_all_32: (instance_id, event_id) reproduces exactly as recorded in per_state.json
J0 reproduces bit-identically to the recorded float (printed at full repr)
snapshot_state_hash recomputes and matches between capture and restore
restore -> resume produces a suffix bit-identical to the original rollout suffix (resume parity)
denominator_rules: all 32 states stay in the denominator; a state that fails to reproduce is recorded as a FAILED row, never dropped
an empty or unproducible state is recorded as-is, not replaced
no substitution of another asset, and no reconstruction of missing fields from downstream values
identity_rules: every input and code file above must match its recorded sha256 before the run, else not_qualified
the contract and profile identity gap must be closed first, else the run cannot claim identity

prohibitions_respected: no field was inferred, guessed or back-filled
no snapshot was invented or reconstructed from downstream values
no execution was performed; the asset was read only
no frozen tree, gate, checkpoint or sealed result was modified
not_a_claim: This file records the qualification status and the design of the recovery test. It does NOT assert that the 32 states have been recovered, and it does not re-establish any I3 qualification. stable_online_gain remains false.
